title: Select Non-Overlapping Ads
real_world_story: An advertising platform has a limited number of time slots during a day. Each advertisement has a start time and an end time, and overlapping advertisements cannot use the same slot. Select the maximum number of advertisements that can be scheduled without overlap.

real_world_connection.input_represents: Start and end times of advertisements
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Selecting advertisements that leave the most remaining time for other ads

problem_statement: Given N advertisements with start and end times, select the maximum number of non-overlapping advertisements. An advertisement that starts at the same time another advertisement ends can be scheduled.
task: Find the maximum number of advertisements that can be scheduled without overlapping.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N integers representing the start times. The third line contains N integers representing the end times.
output_format: Print the maximum number of non-overlapping advertisements that can be scheduled.

examples.explanation: After sorting by end time, advertisements (1,2), (3,4), and (8,9) can be selected without overlap.
Advertisements (1,3) and (4,7) can be selected, giving two non-overlapping advertisements.

expected_algorithm.name: Activity Selection
expected_algorithm.reason: Selecting the advertisement that finishes earliest leaves the maximum possible remaining time for future advertisements.

hint: Sort advertisements by their ending time.
Select the first advertisement that finishes earliest.
Continue selecting an advertisement only when its start time is at least the end time of the last selected advertisement.
real_world_takeaway: Activity selection helps advertising platforms schedule the largest possible number of non-overlapping advertisements.
